(2) I reimplemented that formula and fed it the real light-theme token values from client/src/styles.css (`--rail: #f4f6f9` -> rgb(244,246,249); `--panel: #fbfcfe` -> rgb(251,252,254); `--background: oklch(100% 0 0deg)` -> rgb(255,255,255); `--elevate: oklch(93.5% 0.006 240.4deg)` -> rgb(230,234,237)). Literal results: `--elevate` over `--rail` = 80.65 (the doc says 80 - my model reproduces the doc's own measurement, which validates it); `--rail` over `--panel` = 19.58 (the doc says 20 - CORRECT); `--panel` over `--background` = 5.25 (the doc says 5 - CORRECT); `--rail` over `--background` = 44.72 (the doc implies 20 - WRONG).
